facts.text: I need help finding a good dog walker in my area.
I want recommendations or a list of services that can connect me with a reliable dog walker.
I have a dog named Max.
I use flea and tick prevention medication for Max.
I apply Max's flea and tick prevention medication every two weeks.
I am thinking of getting Max a new toy to keep him engaged during the day while I am away.
I think Max would love the Kong Toy.
I want to stuff a Kong with peanut butter-filled Kongs as a special treat for Max.
I am thinking of getting Max a new collar with a nice name tag.
I am considering a collar brand or type that would suit a Golden Retriever like Max.
I will go with a nylon collar from Yellow Dog Design.
I have heard great things about Yellow Dog Design products.
Yellow Dog Design has a wide range of styles and colors to choose from.
A nylon collar will be durable and easy to clean for Max's active lifestyle.
I can get a nice engraved name tag to go with the collar.
